items.title: Jensen Huang’s Troubles Leave the AI Industry Reeling
items.summary: With a big checkbook and sought-after chips, Nvidia’s CEO had his thumb on the world of AI. An extramarital affair with a suspected Chinese spy may put all of that at risk.
items.author: Will Knight, Paresh Dave

items.title: Jensen Huang Hired a PR Firm Known for Handling Sex Scandals Last Year
items.summary: The Nvidia CEO began working with consultants from Heller as early as October 2025, around the same time he was first linked to a suspected Chinese spy.
items.author: Lauren Goode

items.title: Authors Can Defend Against AI Allegations With ‘Paper Trail’ Tools. Is It Enough?
items.summary: As the publishing industry wrestles with paranoia over the provenance of manuscripts, writers are caught in an impossible bind.
items.author: Miles Klee

items.title: Bikers and Bug-Lovers Join Forces to Fight a New Google Data Center
items.summary: As data center protests break out across Europe, a mismatched band of campaigners is trying to block Google from building a sprawling new facility east of London.
items.author: Joel Khalili
